# LumiBase

> Edge-native headless CMS built for modern web development. Open-source (MIT), deployed on Cloudflare Workers, privacy-first, multi-tenant by default.

LumiBase runs content APIs at the edge — close to users — instead of on a central server. It supports dual deployment (Cloudflare Workers and Docker), delivers content through a type-safe REST API, and includes an AI Copilot with human-in-the-loop approval for dangerous operations.
